name: Do You Believe in Second Chances?
author: Will-o'-the-Wisp
bootlegger: A Leviathan cannot be created past day 5 or after more than 1 good players have been executed.
If the Zombuul is one of the first 4 players to have died, the Zombuul gains a Traveler's ability and registers as a Traveler, but still has the Zombuul's ability.
While the Zombuul registers as a Traveler, it is considered to have "died once."
